name: Community (Ummah)

definition_by_age.4: The friends and family around us.
definition_by_age.6: Ummah means the big family of Muslims around the world who care for each other.
definition_by_age.8: Ummah is the global Muslim community, connected by shared faith and care for one another.

learning_objective: Children can describe helping someone outside their immediate family.

recommended_default.note: Added 2026-08-05 during conflict/pattern expansion — real conflict now exists for this concept, closing a prior retrieval-diversity gap.

hd_012.reasoning: Directly and vividly about community/ummah interconnection.

qv_016.reasoning: Comprehensive, direct verse on kindness to neighbors/relatives/community.

alternative_patterns.reasoning: Skipping a family-gathering responsibility fits neglect-then-repair directly.
